title: Airport Crisis: Flight 472 Emergency
synopsis: During the pre-departure rush for Flight SW 472 to New York at SkyWays International Terminal 1, a $3.5M high-value consignment of industrial diamonds is stolen via an insider luggage swap. An identical blue hard-shell suitcase with a duplicated tag (#SKW-78921-472) was abandoned at Gate B07 as an unattended decoy to trigger a sterile zone security hold, while the authentic diamond-laden suitcase was covertly intercepted on Apron Bay 3 and diverted into an airport maintenance cart. A 3-agent relay team must extract visual forensic evidence from CCTV cameras, baggage scanner telemetry, staff access logs, incident reports, torn drop notes, and baggage tag reprint audits to unmask the insider culprit, prove the luggage swap method, and intercept the stolen diamonds before departure clearance.

noisy_case_file:
INCIDENT DOSSIER - SKYWAYS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
Date: 12 Nov 2024 | Location: Terminal 1, Gate B07 & Apron Bay 3 | Incident Ref: #OPS-SEC-472
Investigating Desk: Airport Security Intelligence & Anti-Contraband Taskforce

OVERVIEW:
Visual evidence, digital telemetry, physical crime scene artifacts, and administrative logs have been assembled concerning the pre-departure theft and baggage swap affecting Flight SW 472 bound for New York.

COLLECTION OF MULTI-SOURCE VISUAL EVIDENCE:

1. CCTV Feed [CAM 03 - Check-in Area A] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:14:23):
- Passenger Daniel Kim checks in at Counter A04 with ticket agent Priya Sharma (Badge SKY-412).
- Digital scale displays checked blue polycarbonate luggage weight: 18.4 kg. SkyWays barcode tag #SKW-78921-472 attached.
- Luggage clears primary conveyor scanner and heads towards sub-terminal sorting.

2. CCTV Feed [CAM 12 - Gate B07 Corridor] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 08:47:10):
- An individual wearing a dark navy hooded windbreaker and black gloves is captured walking quickly away from Gate B07.
- Critical observation: Subject is wearing heavy tarmac safety boots with bright orange high-visibility soles (Ramp Crew standard issue Spec RAMP-882).
- Subject reaches the end of Corridor B and unlocks staff-only door B-Staff-03 leading directly down to Apron Bay 3.

3. CCTV Feed [CAM 21 - Baggage Bay Area / Apron Stand B07] (Timestamp: 2024-11-12 09:02:55):
- Ramp baggage crew active loading containers into the aft cargo hold of Flight SW 472.
- Yellow maintenance utility cart #MC-08 is parked near the belt conveyor base.
- Under cover of the loading conveyor, a blue hard-shell suitcase matching Daniel Kim's checked 18.4 kg bag is diverted off the ramp belt and stowed inside utility cart #MC-08.

4. Flight Information Display System & Consignment Telemetry [Terminal 1 Display Screen] (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:30):
- Flight SW 472 | Destination: New York (JFK) | Gate: B07 | Status: Boarding
- Customs Consignment Manifest #DIA-904: Uncut industrial diamonds valued at $3.5M registered in checked hold cargo for Flight SW 472.
- Flight SW 318 | Destination: London | Gate: B04 | Status: On Time
- Flight SW 561 | Destination: Dubai | Gate: B09 | Status: Delayed

5. Passenger WhatsApp Chat Screenshot [Passenger Aarav Mehta] (Timestamps: 08:35 - 08:47):
- 08:35 - Aarav Mehta: 'Hey, I just reached Gate B07. Boarding queue starting.'
- 08:46 - Aarav Mehta: 'Wait... there\'s a blue bag near the window seats... looks unattended. Saw a guy in a dark hoodie and bright orange boot soles rush into the staff door.'
- 08:47 - Aarav Mehta: 'Alerting gate desk now.'

6. Security Observation & Portable X-Ray Report #SEC-0849 [Officer R. Nair Photo] (Timestamp: 12 Nov 2024 08:49):
- Location: Gate B07 seating area
- Reporting Officer: R. Nair (Badge #AVSEC-9042)
- Findings: Blue suitcase abandoned at window seats. Portable scale reads: 12.1 kg (6.3 kg discrepancy from 18.4 kg check-in).
- Portable X-ray density scan: Item contains dense ballast and sand packets—NO passenger clothing, electronics, or personal travel items.
- Action Taken: Established sterile cordon. Awaiting K9 explosive sweep and fraud taskforce.

7. Concourse Blueprint Drawing & Electronic Door Log [Door B-Staff-03] (Timestamp: 08:47:45):
- Architectural floor plan shows door B-Staff-03 links Gate B07 corridor directly to apron ground level (Stand B07).
- Electronic RFID card-swipe log records access to Door B-Staff-03 at 08:47:45 by Badge #RAMP-882 (Tariq Malik, Senior Ramp Baggage Supervisor).

8. Physical Evidence Recovered at Gate B07:
- Handwritten slip found near seats: 'Meet at B07 - Decoy down - move real box to Cart 08'.
- Forensic handwriting comparison confirms slant and uppercase lettering match the daily Ramp Dispatch Logbook signed by Tariq Malik.

9. Baggage Tag Forensic Audit [Decoy Bag at Gate B07]:
- SkyWays baggage tag reads: 'Passenger: Daniel Kim | Flight: SW 472 | Tag: #SKW-78921-472'.
- Micro-print security watermark on lower edge: 'REPRINT-MGR-02 / AUTH-ID: RAMP-882 (Tariq Malik) / TIME: 08:16:05'.
- Confirms duplicate tag was reprinted using Tariq Malik's supervisory keycard shortly after Kim checked in.

10. Decoy / Irrelevant Peripheral Material:
- The Daily Chronicle newspaper discarded on chair: 'City Marathon Brings Thousands Together - The annual city marathon saw a record 25,000 participants.'
- Catering service log: Routine morning coffee delivery to lounge at 08:20.
operational_rules: Rule SEC-101 (Sterile Zone Unattended Baggage Protocol): Any unattended baggage detected in passenger departure/boarding gates must be immediately cordoned off and subjected to certified explosive detection / K9 unit inspection.

Rule BAGG-204 (Baggage Chain-of-Custody & Tag Duplicate Protocol): Manual reprinting or duplication of automated baggage tags requires multi-factor supervisor authorization; any weight discrepancy exceeding 1.0 kg between check-in scale telemetry and gate intercept flags an immediate chain-of-custody fraud alarm.

Rule OPS-204 (Pre-Departure Security Hold Protocol): No commercial flight assigned to a gate under an unresolved security investigation, unattended baggage incident, or ramp cargo diversion may push back, board passengers, or be cleared for departure until authorized by the Security Director.

ground_truth.valid_action: Hold Flight SW 472 at Gate B07 immediately, suspend passenger boarding, cordon off the Gate B07 seating area, dispatch the K9 explosive detection unit, and detain Tariq Malik to intercept Maintenance Cart #MC-08.
